props.name: onSubmit
props.description: The function that is called when the form is submitted. It returns the values object that contains all fields values

props.name: initialValues
props.description: Default values of the form fields

props.name: validateOnChange
props.description: If the form should trigger validation and show errors while typing

props.name: validateOnBlur
props.description: If the form should trigger validation and show errors when the field is out of focus
